subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **" To"** is used to indicate effect or relation,** which is suitable in this context to show how something negatively impacts something else.**
 
• The phrase** “detrimental to”** correctly expresses harm or damage towards something, in this case, the ecosystem.
 
• **"To"** accurately connects the cause **(plastic becoming part of the animal food chain) **and effect **(detriment to the ecosystem)** in a cause-effect relationship.
 
• This usage fits well within the passage's structure, maintaining clarity and** grammatical correctness.**
 
• The term** "detrimental to"** is a common collocation, meaning it is often used together in similar **contexts to indicate harmful effects.**
 
• By using** "to," **the sentence succinctly conveys the overall negative impact **without ambiguity.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"In"** suggests location or position, which doesn't express the cause-effect relationship needed here.
 
• **"For" **implies purpose or benefit, which is contrary to the intended negative connotation.
 
• **"On"** indicates a surface or topic but does not correctly convey the relationship of harm or impact in this context.
